3fd883c3: Which role does the champion Ashe play in League of Legends?
Ashe is a classic ADC (marksman), a ranged damage dealer who plays in the bot lane. She is often recommended to beginners learning the role.
4ad0ceda: What is the main resource most champions use to cast their spells?
Mana is the main resource champions spend to cast their spells. Some use Energy or other alternative resources.
3f6f0871: What is “Baron Nashor” in League of Legends?
A powerful objective in the top side of the jungle
Baron Nashor is the most powerful monster on the map, in the top side of the river. Killing it gives the whole team a powerful buff.
c8b590ba: Which main map is used in classic League of Legends games?
Summoner's Rift is the main three-lane map: top lane, mid lane, bot lane, plus the jungle.
f152d093: What is a “pentakill” in League of Legends?
Killing all 5 enemies in quick succession
A pentakill means taking down all 5 enemy players within a short time, one of the most satisfying feats in the game.
15e364db: What is the role of the Support in a standard team?
Helping the ADC in bot lane and protecting the team
The Support accompanies the ADC in bot lane to protect them, using heals, shields or crowd control to help the team in fights.
657b2882: What is the name of the late-game dragon that lets you execute weakened enemies?
The Elder Dragon appears late in the game. Its buff lets you execute enemies who drop below a certain health threshold.
9c6479bb: What is a “gank” in League of Legends?
Surprising an enemy from outside their lane to take them down
A gank is when the jungler leaves the jungle to attack an enemy in a lane, creating a temporary numbers advantage.
a650a316: Which assassin champion resets her abilities with every takedown?
Katarina is the assassin known for her resets: takedowns lower her cooldowns, allowing devastating multikills.
94ab0e9e: What does the Teleport summoner spell do?
Teleport lets you channel to an allied turret (and later to minions or wards), used to get back to lane quickly or flank in a fight.
4b951f1c: Which summoner spell, the most used in the game, blinks the champion a short distance?
Flash is the most used summoner spell: it teleports the champion a short distance to dodge, engage or escape.
33587d60: What is the middle lane called in League of Legends?
Mid lane is the central lane, often played by mages or assassins who can easily influence the neighboring lanes.
24e85121: What is the name of the company that develops League of Legends?
Riot Games has developed and published League of Legends since 2009. The company was founded by Brandon Beck and Marc Merrill.
0e4fb80b: In what year was League of Legends released?
League of Legends officially launched on October 27, 2009, and quickly became one of the most played PC games in the world.
123688d0: What does killing a Dragon give the team?
Permanent buffs depending on its type
Each Dragon gives the team a permanent buff depending on its type: Cloud (movement), Infernal (damage), Mountain (resistances), Ocean (regeneration), and so on.
d11bdf3e: What is “CS” or “farm” in League of Legends?
CS (creep score) is the number of minions killed: each one gives gold, which is essential for buying items.
1c94de12: Which LoL champion is one of the iconic ice mages?
Lissandra is the Ice Witch of the Freljord, a control mage who can encase herself in ice to dodge or engage.
3c8848c2: Attacking an enemy under their own turret
Tower diving means attacking an enemy who is sheltering under their turret: risky, since the turret fights back, so timing is key.
cdb6de22: What is the name of Europe's professional LoL league?
The LEC (League of Legends EMEA Championship, formerly the EU LCS) is Europe's professional league, based in Berlin.
2fa8dfe1: Which global LoL event brings together the best teams every year?
The World Championship (Worlds) is the annual global tournament, one of the most watched esports events in the world.
b78d7f94: Which region has historically dominated LoL Worlds?
South Korea (LCK) has historically dominated Worlds, with teams such as SKT T1 (now T1) and Samsung, and legendary players like Faker.
c7a429a6: Who is Faker in the world of League of Legends esports?
The most decorated mid laner in history
Lee “Faker” Sang-hyeok, T1's mid laner, is considered the greatest League of Legends player of all time. He holds the record for World Championship titles.
7f8e08fc: What is the name of the icy, mysterious region in League of Legends lore?
The Freljord is the frozen northern region, home to hardy warriors and ice creatures. Ashe, Sejuani and Lissandra vie for power there.
83b599a0: What genre of game is League of Legends?
League of Legends is a MOBA, a strategic team game in which two teams of 5 players fight to destroy the enemy base.
c4255df0: What is the name of the technologically advanced, steampunk-flavored city in LoL?
Piltover is the city of progress, where engineers, inventors and hextech thrive above Zaun, the polluted undercity.
eaa4927c: Which yordle ninja wields electricity and throws shuriken?
Kennen, the Heart of the Tempest, is an electric yordle ninja who throws stunning shuriken and can stun an entire team with his ultimate.
df019f81: What is “warding” in League of Legends?
Warding means placing wards (vision totems) on the map, essential for avoiding ganks and watching objectives.
1383b550: Which LoL spin-off is an auto battler for eight players?
Teamfight Tactics (TFT) is the 8-player auto battler set in the LoL universe, where players build teams of champions that fight automatically.
6414ad67: Which champion is a being of fire whose spells set targets ablaze?
Brand, the Burning Vengeance, sets enemies ablaze and spreads flames. His abilities gain extra effects on burning targets.
e1545093: What is LoL's “all mid” game mode called?
ARAM (All Random All Mid) is the popular alternative mode: champions are assigned at random and everyone fights in a single lane.
ad1345fd: What is the name of the militaristic, imperialist region in LoL lore?
Noxus is the militaristic empire that values strength and merit, a long-standing rival of Demacia. Its champions include Darius, Draven and Katarina.
7acb4e52: Which LoL champion embodies justice and wears gleaming armor?
Garen, the Might of Demacia, is the iconic Demacian soldier: simple and powerful, with his spinning sword and his ultimate, Demacian Justice. “Demacia!”
b562045d: What is “split pushing” as a strategy in LoL?
Pushing a lane alone while the team pressures elsewhere
Split pushing means pushing a side lane alone to force the enemy to send players to stop you, opening up objectives for the rest of your team.
9972d5fb: What is the name of the LoL champion who transforms into a wild beast?
Nidalee is the huntress who can turn into a cougar, switching between a human kit and a beast kit.
ec067b90: Which lich can hit every enemy on the map with his ultimate?
Karthus is the lich whose ultimate hits every enemy champion on the map: he can kill someone on the other side of the map from his lane.
660f31c7: What is League of Legends' premium currency called?
Riot Points (RP) are the premium currency bought with real money, used for skins, champions and cosmetic content.
d4faadf1: Which support can heal all her allies anywhere on the map with her ultimate?
Soraka is the purest healing support: she heals her allies heavily and her ultimate heals them all, wherever they are on the map.
13dd0e33: What is “Smite” in League of Legends?
A summoner spell for killing jungle monsters
Smite is the jungler's essential summoner spell: it deals heavy damage to neutral monsters and lets you steal enemy objectives.
fbfc30d8: Which LoL champion can steal an enemy's ultimate?
Sylas can steal the ultimate of any enemy champion with Hijack, a unique and complex mechanic to master.
e4acd6fa: What is the name of the main structure to protect in each base?
The Nexus is the central structure each team must protect: destroying it ends the game in victory for the other team.
4e985f73: Which type of LoL champion soaks up damage on the front line?
Tanks are tough champions who absorb damage on the front line, protecting their team and starting fights.
90dc953b: What is the name of the mobile version of LoL released in 2020?
League of Legends: Wild Rift is the version built for mobile (and console), with gameplay adapted to touch controls.
b1a59f33: Which artist made the song “Enemy” for Arcane?
“Enemy” by Imagine Dragons and JID is the theme of Arcane (2021), the Netflix animated series based on League of Legends lore.
efa2bb53: What is the name of the Netflix animated series based on LoL lore?
Arcane is the Netflix animated series (2021) exploring the origins of Jinx and Vi in Piltover and Zaun. Widely acclaimed, it got a second season in 2024.
e7533a5b: Which LoL champion is a mermaid-like Tidecaller from the sea?
Nami, the Tidecaller, is an enchanter support from the depths of the sea who heals, empowers and controls with waves of water.
d65f6509: What is the highest rank in LoL's ranked system?
Challenger is League of Legends' highest rank: only a few hundred of the best players in each region can reach it.
84c92aac: What is the name of the world in which League of Legends' story takes place?
Runeterra is League of Legends' fictional world, with regions such as Demacia, Noxus, Piltover, the Freljord, Ionia and Shurima.
23294d93: What is the name of Zed's assassination technique using his shadow?
Death Mark is Zed's ultimate: he dashes to the target, leaving a shadow behind, and marks them for delayed damage that bursts them down.
8826bbf0: Which LoL champion is known for his ultimate “Chronoshift”, which rewinds time?
Zilean, the Chronokeeper, can slow or speed up time, and his ultimate Chronoshift revives an ally who would have died.
87f80e81: What is the top lane called in LoL?
Top lane is the upper lane, usually played by tanks or fighters who can handle a long 1v1 lane on their own.
ca26ab33: Which rank sits just below Challenger?
Grandmaster is the second-highest rank after Challenger, a small band of elite players competing for a place in Challenger.
21154e43: Which clown champion creates a copy of himself with his ultimate, Hallucinate?
Shaco, the Demon Jester, creates a clone of himself with Hallucinate, which makes it very hard to tell which one is real.
d412e721: Which stat reduces incoming physical damage?
Armor reduces incoming physical damage, while magic resist (MR) reduces magic damage. Both are essential for tanks.
2342d3dd: What are Zaun's criminal bosses called in the Piltover/Zaun lore?
The Chem-Barons are the criminal bosses who control Zaun's districts. In Arcane, Silco is the most developed figure of this underworld.
611c0a32: What is the area of the base where champions respawn called?
The Fountain is the spawn and respawn area. It quickly restores health and mana, and a powerful laser protects it.
90b26dcc: Which LoL champion is known for using chains and an anchor?
Nautilus, the Titan of the Depths, wields an anchor and chains: his Dredge Line hooks enemies, and his ultimate sends a shockwave that knocks up everyone in its path.
482e6dcb: Which LoL champion from Ionia is known for wielding the wind?
Yasuo, the Unforgiven, is an Ionian swordsman who wields the wind. His personal story is complex and tormented.
a3caa51c: What is the name of the mage champion who uses stars and meteors?
Aurelion Sol, the Star Forger, is a celestial dragon who shapes stars and galaxies. His 2023 rework was among the best received.
ad8b1430: Which LoL champion uses frost arrows and can slow from afar?
Ashe, the Frost Archer, slows targets with her basic attacks, and her ultimate is a global ice arrow that stuns the first champion it hits.
95cfc64b: What is the name of Riven's rapid attack technique?
Broken Wings is Riven's Q: a series of 3 dashing strikes that defines her kit and acrobatic fighting style.
5f1c6b7e: What is the role of an “enchanter” support?
An enchanter is a protection-focused support who heals, shields and buffs allies rather than engaging or crowd-controlling enemies.
3fe960ba: What is the name of the yordles' homeland in LoL?
Bandle City is the yordles' magical home, a realm whose hidden pathways open into Runeterra.
e007b2ac: Which LoL champion is a little girl who uses fire magic and a teddy bear?
Annie, the Dark Child, can summon Tibbers, her teddy bear turned into a giant flaming bear, one of the game's most iconic ultimates.
